description: A3 task 12a (F10; #735): the old build's TASK-001 and TASK-002 Review-row checks carried onto Round 7's movement rows on /review and /workout — ReviewExerciseRow (src/ui/review-exercise-row.tsx) and BlockPanel.Movement/TimedWorkoutFlow over MovementIdentity, MovementList and MovementGroupHeader (src/ui/movement-presentation.tsx): equipment inline on the name line, Swap only in Review, expanded sections under static semantic headings with no toggle, separators only between peers. Only the tests come back; no product file changes. check-01 runs the two files this task owns whole (owner decisions of 2026-11-18, decision 3) and declares every case in them: src/ui/movement-list.test.tsx (created here with the build's TASK-001 block) and src/ui/movement-identity.test.tsx (TASK-118's carried TASK-029 block, then the build's TASK-002 block added here); TASK-001 and TASK-002 check-01/check-02 (their task-001 and task-002 e2e suites) prove JOURNEY-001 and JOURNEY-002 on the routes. parity compares /review's and /workout's movement rows with the accepted cards state at 320 and 390 (TASK-AC-1AFEF9A3EE07). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-112 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/movement-list.test.tsx src/ui/movement-identity.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
